# CNN

> Global news network delivering breaking news, analysis, and video coverage across world events, U.S. politics, business, and international affairs.

CNN provides comprehensive journalism covering major stories including Trump administration developments, international conflicts (Iran, China), economic trends, and regional news from the Americas, Europe, Asia, Middle East, and Africa. The platform features polling data, video channels, and real-time breaking news updates.

## Key Topics

- Donald Trump
- Trump approval ratings
- Iran conflict
- Strait of Hormuz
- U.S.-China relations
- Breaking news coverage
- Political polling
- Presidential approval tracking
- Americas news
- Economic policy
- International relations
- Video journalism
- Poll aggregation
- Immigration policy
- Federal Reserve policy

## Core News Coverage

- [Breaking News, Latest News and Videos | CNN](https://edition.cnn.com/): CNN homepage with breaking news on U.S., world, politics & entertainment
- [World news - breaking news, video, headlines and opinion | CNN](https://edition.cnn.com/world.html): International news from Europe, Asia, Middle East, Africa & Americas
- [US | CNN](https://edition.cnn.com/us): US news covering immigration, law enforcement & domestic policy
- [CNN Headlines | CNN](https://edition.cnn.com/videos/fast/cnn-headlines): Curated video channel covering major news across politics & entertainment

## Regional Coverage

- [Americas news - breaking news, video, headlines and opinion | CNN](https://edition.cnn.com/world/americas/index.html): Americas news covering Venezuela, Mexico, Canada & Latin America
- [China news - breaking news, video, headlines and opinion | CNN](https://edition.cnn.com/world/china): China news covering US-China relations, Taiwan, technology & economy

## Politics & Administration

- [Donald J. Trump news | CNN Politics](https://edition.cnn.com/politics/president-donald-trump-47): Trump administration news with approval ratings & executive actions
- [CNN Polls | CNN Politics](https://edition.cnn.com/polling): Political polling data tracking Trump, Congress & presidential approval

## Business & Economy

- [Economy | CNN Business](https://edition.cnn.com/business/economy): Economic news with market data, inflation, jobs & Fed policy coverage
